idea-plugin.name: Markdown Lens – Preview and Diff
idea-plugin.description:
A polished, feature-rich Markdown preview for JetBrains IDEs with Mermaid diagrams and rendered Markdown diffs. Diffs show both versions rendered side by side, with synchronized scrolling and change markers.
  • GitHub Flavored Markdown: Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX math (KaTeX), tables, task lists, strikethrough, footnotes, highlighted code blocks.
  • Zoom and pan for diagrams and images: buttons, mouse wheel, fit to content, actual size.
  • YAML and TOML frontmatter shown as a collapsible metadata block.
  • Table of contents panel, heading anchors, and file paths that open in the editor.
  • Scroll and selection sync between the editor and the preview.
  • Follows IDE theme colors; separate font size and page zoom settings.

registryKey.description: Enable the rendered Markdown preview mode in the diff viewer
